Justification: The response is exceptionally detailed, covering market diagnostics, regulatory tables, persona segmentation, timelines, budgets, and go-to-market tactics. It provides specific examples (e.g., Zakat calculator, Wadiah products) and comprehensive implementation steps.

It avoids a one-size-fits-all approach and respects local regulatory and religious expectations.
